description: Check whether a web page has changed since you last looked. Returns the page's main text and a fingerprint (hash); send back previous_hash to get changed true/false, or previous_text to also get the lines added and removed. Optional CSS selector to watch just one part (a price, a stock status, a notice). Use for monitoring prices, policies, job boards, competitors or announcements. Send {url, previous_hash?, previous_text?, selector?}. Errors: 400 bad URL, 422 selector not found. Price: $0.003 USDC per call (x402).

previous_text.description: text from your last check (gives added/removed lines)

selector.description: Optional CSS selector to watch only part of the page, e.g. .price

name: page_change_check
title: Web page change detector
